cartographer.declared_question: Must every referenced dependency travel with a plate, or can a verifiable reference remain sufficient?
cartographer.inquiry_basis: Existing OCI proposals REL-P-000008 and REL-P-000009 and exact FN-33's independent-reconstruction question.

sources_checked.attribution: Open Container Initiative Image Specification 1.1.1, Content Descriptors
source_facts: Descriptors identify referenced content by media type, digest, and raw byte size.
Consumers are directed to check retrieved content against its stated size and digest.
sources_checked.inference: A verifiable content reference can support integrity checking, but does not itself carry the referenced bytes or preserve an artistic encounter.
sources_checked.uncertainty: Document comparison only, not a fresh interoperability test or claim about later OCI versions.

sources_checked.attribution: Open Container Initiative Image Specification 1.1.1, Image Layout
source_facts: A layout can omit referenced blobs and obtain them from an external blob store.
sources_checked.inference: A content-addressed package is not necessarily a self-contained preservation copy. This limit remains relevant to FN-33 and FN-40's distinction between carrying bytes and carrying an address.
sources_checked.uncertainty: Technical adjacency does not establish architectural equivalence, endorsement, affiliation, or authorized edition lineage.

cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The existing OCI node and proposed edge already record the dependency and external-storage distinction. Another proposal would duplicate that evidence. No graph claim or ratification was changed.

Care: Earlier releases, exact works, audio, graph claims, historical audits, and the three-item selection remain intact. No relational essay was manufactured.
Checks: 93 tests, four-width browser checks, FN-40 search and exact-download checks, source hashes, links, catalog evidence, all 62 recordings, and the complete multipart mirror passed.
Outcome: One catalog evidence repair passed publication checks. No new relationship or ratification was made; deployment is verified separately after merge.
